systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Pulsed High-Voltage Electric Discharge & Hydrodynamic Cavitation Disruption Skid

systemArchitectures.technology: In-Line Continuous Coaxial Pulsed Electric Field Treatment Chamber (15–40 kV/cm, 10–50 µs square wave, 100–500 Hz solid-state IGBT switch) coupled directly with Multi-Orifice Hydrodynamic Cavitation Micro-Jet Venturi (6–20 bar inlet pressure, cavitation number σ < 0.22, bubble collapse shockwave ΔP > 1,200 bar), High-Pressure Ceramic Piston Feed Pump, In-Line Dual Concentric Glycol Chiller Jacket (ΔT < 2.5°C), and Automated Back-Pressure Regulating (BPR) Valve

systemArchitectures.description: Flagship commercial continuous electroporation and hydrodynamic cavitation disruption skid. microalgaeSpecies.name: Chlorella vulgaris (Rigid Cellulosic / Algaenan Multilayer Wall)
microalgaeSpecies.wallStructure: Trilaminar rigid envelope comprising an outer hydrophobic algaenan (sporopollenin-like polymer) layer and an inner microfibrillar cellulose-hemicellulose matrix (resistant to enzymatic and osmotic lysis).
microalgaeSpecies.description: Standard unicellular green microalga celebrated for high-value vegan protein and lutein. Its microfibrillar algaenan wall requires the dual synergistic attack of PEF electroporation to form nanoscale membrane pores followed by HCD micro-jet shear shockwaves to fracture the rigid skeleton without heat degradation.

microalgaeSpecies.name: Spirulina platensis (Arthrospira platensis - Fragile Peptidoglycan Wall)
microalgaeSpecies.wallStructure: Multi-layered cyanobacterial peptidoglycan / murein envelope without structural cellulose or algaenan. Readily permeabilized under low-to-moderate electric fields.
microalgaeSpecies.description: High-value cyanobacterium producing brilliant blue C-phycocyanin. Extremely heat-sensitive: temperatures exceeding 40°C cause irreversible chromophore protein denaturation and discoloration. PEF-HCD achieves near-complete intracellular phycocyanin release under ambient chilled conditions (18–24°C) with an exceptional purity ratio (A620/A280 ≥ 2.8).

microalgaeSpecies.name: Haematococcus pluvialis (Encysted Thick-Walled Aplanospores)
microalgaeSpecies.wallStructure: Heavy, multilayered encysted cell wall enriched with sporopollenin, acetolysis-resistant algaenan biopolymers, and an inner thick mannan-cellulose secondary wall.
microalgaeSpecies.description: The richest natural source of astaxanthin, encapsulated in thick cyst envelopes (aplanospores). Conventional disruption requires intense ball milling that introduces ceramic dust and oxidizes astaxanthin isomers. The PEF-HCD system punches nano-channels through the sporopollenin cyst shell, enabling continuous, solvent-free astaxanthin extraction.

microalgaeSpecies.name: Nannochloropsis oculata (Marine Microalgae / Recalcitrant Poly-Aliphatic Wall)
microalgaeSpecies.wallStructure: Dense, recalcitrant outer layer of cross-linked aliphatic algaenans covalently bound to an inner crystalline cellulosic sheath.
microalgaeSpecies.description: Premier marine source of EPA omega-3 lipids. Due to its diminutive cell size (3 µm) and rigid polymer shell, traditional bead milling requires microscopic beads (0.2 mm) that foul readily and overheat. PEF-HCD achieves non-thermal continuous cell envelope rupture and rapid lipid partitioning without chemical emulsifiers.

microalgaeSpecies.name: Conventional High-Energy Agitated Bead Milling (Industrial Benchmark)
microalgaeSpecies.wallStructure: Mechanical grinding via dense zirconia or glass ceramic beads (0.3–0.8 mm) inside a high-speed agitated grinding chamber (rotor tip speed 12–16 m/s).
microalgaeSpecies.description: Baseline legacy grinding technology. Suffers from high specific electrical power consumption (>2.4 kWh/kg dry biomass), massive viscous heat generation (ΔT > 25°C requiring multi-stage refrigeration), severe protein shear denaturation, and release of sub-micron abrasive ceramic zirconia bead fragments into food-grade extracts.

microalgaeSpecies.name: Conventional Toxic Solvent Extraction (Hexane/Methanol Chemical Benchmark)
microalgaeSpecies.wallStructure: Chemical organic solvent permeabilization and lipid dissolution utilizing boiling n-hexane and methanol mixtures (60–70°C).
microalgaeSpecies.description: Legacy chemical solvent extraction. Presents catastrophic explosive vapor risks, severe environmental volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions, high energy distillation costs for solvent recovery, denatured protein byproducts unsuitable for human consumption, and toxic solvent residues (200–500 ppm) violating USP <467> and FDA guidelines.

reactorCavitationGeometries.name: Multi-Orifice Radial Cavitation Plate (Laser-Microdrilled Hastelloy C-276)
reactorCavitationGeometries.description: Symmetrical circular pattern of micro-orifices accelerating microalgal slurry into high-velocity micro-jets. Generates dense cloud cavitation that collapses symmetrically on downstream recovery, creating uniform shear stresses without localized erosion.

reactorCavitationGeometries.name: Sanitary 3-A Converging-Diverging Venturi Tube (Titanium Grade 5)
reactorCavitationGeometries.description: Smooth 18° entrance convergence and 7° exit diffuser engineered according to ASME standards. Produces low pressure drops, minimal dead zones, self-draining CIP geometry, and high bubble nucleation rates.

reactorCavitationGeometries.name: High-Shear Vortex Swirl Cavitation Reactor (Zirconia Ceramic Insert)
reactorCavitationGeometries.description: Induces intense cyclonic rotational flow with a deep axial pressure depression. Cavitation bubbles nucleate in the low-pressure core and are centrifugally forced into the outer high-pressure wall zone, imploding with tremendous energy against microalgal suspensions.

transmembranePotential.name: Schwan's Equation for Induced Transmembrane Potential
transmembranePotential.formula: ΔΨ_m(t, θ) = 1.5 · r_cell · E · cos(θ) · [1 - exp(-t / τ_c)]

variables.E: External electric field intensity (V/m or kV/cm)
variables.θ: Angle between electric field lines and membrane surface normal
variables.τ_c: Membrane charging relaxation time constant (τ_c = r_cell · C_m · (1/σ_int + 1/2σ_ext))

transmembranePotential.significance: When ΔΨ_m exceeds the critical threshold Vcrit (0.5 to 1.1 V depending on species), electro-compression and molecular lipid reorientation induce irreversible hydrophilic nano-pore formation (electroporation).

cavitationNumber.name: Hydrodynamic Cavitation Number (σ)

variables.σ: Dimensionless cavitation intensity index (cavitation initiates when σ ≤ 1.0; intense hydrodynamic disruption occurs when σ < 0.25)
variables.P_downstream: Static pressure downstream of the constriction (Pa)
variables.P_vapor: Saturation vapor pressure of water at process temperature (Pa)
variables.v_throat: Fluid velocity through orifice / venturi throat (m/s)

cavitationNumber.significance: Governs the inception, growth, and sudden implosive collapse of vapor micro-bubbles. Lower σ signifies exponentially greater bubble population density and stagnation shockwave pressures.

synergisticDisruptionKinetics.name: Coupled Electro-Cavitative Disruption Kinetic Model

variables.D_cell: Fraction of microalgal cells disrupted (0.0 to 1.0)
variables.W_PEF: Specific electric energy input (kJ/kg dry biomass)
variables.α, β: Non-linear synergy scaling exponents (typically α ≈ 0.85, β ≈ 1.35)

synergisticDisruptionKinetics.significance: Quantifies the non-linear synergy between PEF membrane electro-permeabilization and HCD micro-jet shear shockwaves, explaining why combining both techniques slashes energy requirements by over 80%.

specificEnergyConsumption.name: Total Process Specific Energy Consumption (SEC)

variables.SEC: Specific energy consumption per kg dry biomass (kWh/kg)
variables.P_electrical_PEF: Pulsed electric field power (kW): P_PEF = f_pulse · ∫ V(t)·I(t) dt
variables.P_pump_HCD: Hydraulic pumping power (kW): P_pump = (F_slurry / ρ) · ΔP_HCD / η_pump
variables.C_dry: Biomass dry weight concentration fraction (kg dry / kg slurry)

specificEnergyConsumption.significance: Directly benchmarks operational expenditure against conventional bead mills (2.2–3.0 kWh/kg) and demonstrates commercial economic viability for bio-refinery scale-up.

thermalRiseEquation.name: Slurry Temperature Rise Conservation Law

variables.ΔT: Slurry bulk temperature rise across reaction chamber (°C)
variables.η_acoustic: Fraction of cavitation energy converted to mechanical shockwave work
variables.C_p: Specific heat capacity of microalgae slurry (~3.95 kJ/kg·K)

thermalRiseEquation.significance: Proves that with high-efficiency solid-state pulses and short microsecond durations, bulk temperature rise is kept strictly under 3.5°C, ensuring thermolabile C-phycocyanin and enzymes never cross denaturation thresholds.

regulatoryStandards.title: Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) Affirmation for Direct Food Ingredients & Microalgae Biomass
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: Microalgal proteins, lipids, and pigments extracted via non-chemical water-based physical processing qualify for direct human dietary consumption without toxicological solvent reviews.

regulatoryStandards.title: Current Good Manufacturing Practice, Hazard Analysis, and Risk-Based Preventive Controls for Human Food
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: Demands sanitary stainless steel / titanium construction (Ra ≤ 0.4 µm), clean-in-place (CIP) drainability, and absence of abrasive ceramic bead contaminants in processed foods.

regulatoryStandards.title: Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code: Rules for Construction of Pressure Vessels
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: All cavitation nozzles, pulse chambers, and interconnecting piping must maintain a minimum burst safety factor SF ≥ 4.0 at maximum design pressure (35 bar at 50°C).

regulatoryStandards.title: IEEE Recommended Practices for Safety in High-Voltage and High-Power Testing
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: Requires sub-microsecond dielectric breakdown detection, automated arc-quench crowbar circuits (<1.2 µs shutoff), and fully grounded Faraday cage containment interlocks.

regulatoryStandards.title: United States Pharmacopeia: Residual Solvents and Sub-visible Particulate Matter Limits
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: Zero volatile organic chemical solvents (0.0 ppm residual hexane/methanol) and elimination of particulate shedding from mechanical bead media.

regulatoryStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Rupture Discs, Pressure Relieving Devices, and In-Line Processing Skids
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: All product contact surfaces must be fully drainable, self-cleaning under automated CIP cycles, and free of crevices, threads, or dead legs.

operationalModes.name: Gentle Electroporation & Low-Shear Bioactive Protein Recovery
operationalModes.description: Optimized for heat- and shear-sensitive biomolecules. Uses moderate field strength to perforate cell envelopes without triggering cell fragmentation, releasing intact soluble proteins into clear supernatant.

operationalModes.name: High-Intensity Synergistic Wall Disruption & Lipid Release
operationalModes.targetProduct: EPA / DHA Neutral Lipids, Astaxanthin Oleoresin, Total Lutein
operationalModes.description: Maximum cell disintegration for robust species (*Chlorella*, *Nannochloropsis*, *Haematococcus* cysts). Delivers complete disruption of sporopollenin and algaenan matrices for total intracellular lipid and pigment recovery.

operationalModes.name: High-Throughput Commercial Energy-Minimization Mode
operationalModes.targetProduct: Standard Vegan Protein Isolate & Whole-Cell Digestible Biomass
operationalModes.description: Calculates the exact Pareto optimum between electrical pulse power and hydraulic pumping energy, delivering >92% protein yield at lowest possible kWh/kg operating cost.
